## `neuro.array.slice`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`.

> Returns a copy of a section of an array.
> For both start and end, a negative index can be used to indicate an offset from the end of the array.
> For example, -2 refers to the second to last element of the array.

## Signatures

```ts
slice(input: { array: <receiver>; start?: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.slice` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
